title: Rajasthan Tour Package
overview: Embark on a regal circuit through the Golden Triangle of Rajasthan: Jaipur’s majestic hill forts, Jodhpur’s imposing Mehrangarh fortress, and the romantic golden dunes of Jaisalmer with luxury Swiss tent glamping.
highlights: 2 Nights in Jaipur + 1 Night in Jodhpur + 2 Nights in Jaisalmer + 1 Night Bikaner
Amber Fort Jeep ascent, City Palace, and Hawa Mahal photo stop
Desert Jeep Safari & Camel ride on Sam Sand Dunes with Kalbeliya dance show
Stay in authentic heritage Haveli in Jaipur and Jodhpur
Delicious authentic Rajasthani Dal Baati Churma dinner included
inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation in handpicked heritage hotels & luxury Swiss desert camp
Daily Breakfast and Dinner throughout the journey
Sam Sand Dunes Desert Safari with evening cultural folk performance & buffet
Dedicated private AC Sedan/Innova with experienced interstate chauffeur
All interstate road taxes, toll charges, and parking fees
exclusions: Air/Train fares to Jaipur and from Jodhpur/Jaipur
Monument entry tickets and guide fees at palaces/forts
Personal camera fees, room service, and personal expenses

itinerary.title: Arrival in the Pink City Jaipur & Chokhi Dhani Vibe
itinerary.description: Arrive at Jaipur Airport/Station and check in to your heritage hotel. In the evening, visit the illuminated Albert Hall Museum and explore the bustling Johari Bazaar.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Visit Birla Mandir & Albert Hall Museum

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts: Amber, Jal Mahal, City Palace & Hawa Mahal
itinerary.description: Explore the grand Amber Fort with its mirror palace (Sheesh Mahal). Stop by Jal Mahal floating in Man Sagar Lake, followed by Jaipur City Palace and the iconic honeycomb facade of Hawa Mahal.
itinerary.morningActivity: Amber Fort exploration & Jal Mahal photo stop
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Jaipur City Palace & Jantar Mantar observatory
itinerary.eveningActivity: Sunset view from Nahargarh Fort overlooking Jaipur city

itinerary.title: Jaipur to the Blue City Jodhpur & Mehrangarh Fort
itinerary.description: Drive from Jaipur to Jodhpur (approx. 5.5 hrs). Check in and visit the colossal Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada marble cenotaph, and take a stroll in the indigo-painted Brahmin alleyways.
itinerary.morningActivity: Highway drive to Jodhpur with lunch stop
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Tour of Mehrangarh Fort and Jaswant Thada
itinerary.eveningActivity: Explore Clock Tower market and taste famous Mirchi Vada

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to the Golden Desert City Jaisalmer
itinerary.description: Drive across the Thar Desert to Jaisalmer (approx. 4.5 hrs). Visit the mysterious abandoned village of Kuldhara. Check into your boutique hotel within view of the Golden Fort.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Jaisalmer with Kuldhara village stop
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in and visit Gadisar Lake at sunset
itinerary.eveningActivity: Rooftop dinner overlooking the illuminated golden fort

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Fort, Patwon Ki Haveli & Sam Sand Dunes Safari
itinerary.description: Tour the living Sonar Qila (Golden Fort) and intricately carved Patwon Ki Haveli. In the afternoon, head to Sam Sand Dunes. Enjoy thrilling dune bashing, sunset camel ride, bonfire, folk music, and Kalbeliya dance under the stars.
itinerary.morningActivity: Living Fort walking tour & Jain temples
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Transfer to Luxury Swiss Desert Camp at Sam Dunes
itinerary.eveningActivity: 4x4 Jeep safari, camel ride, folk music & dinner buffet
itinerary.stay: Luxury Swiss Desert Camp, Sam Dunes

itinerary.title: Sam Dunes to Bikaner & Junagarh Fort
itinerary.description: After sunrise over the dunes, drive to Bikaner (approx. 5 hrs). Visit the unvanquished Junagarh Fort with its gilded gold-leaf ceilings, followed by a visit to the National Camel Breeding Farm.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Tour Junagarh Fort and Lalgarh Palace
itinerary.eveningActivity: Taste authentic Bikaneri Bhujia and sweets

itinerary.title: Bikaner to Jaipur / Jodhpur Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and drive back to Jaipur/Jodhpur Airport for onward flight with royal memories.
